about: Experience LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Play through a fun STAR WARS galaxy that combines the endless customization of LEGO® with the epic story from STAR WARS Episodes IV-VI.
Build and ride classic vehicles and get in and out to explore!
Create and customize your own playable STAR WARS characters in millions of different ways.
Boss Levels from LEGO STAR WARS I, Challenge Mode and More.

This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
summary: Experience LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
